definitions.gloss: more, all the more, even more
definitions.explanation: To an even greater degree than before.

examples.japanese: {一層|いっそう}{努力|どりょく}します。
{雨|あめ}で{一層|いっそう}{寒|さむ}くなった。
examples.english: The rain made it even colder.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{一層|いっそう}{美|うつく}しく{見|み}えた。
{練習|れんしゅう}で{一層|いっそう}{上達|じょうたつ}した。
examples.english: Through practice, I improved even more.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}は{一層|いっそう}{複雑|ふくざつ}になった。
examples.english: The problem became even more complicated.

examples.japanese: {一層|いっそう}の{発展|はってん}を{願|ねが}います。
この{経験|けいけん}が{一層|いっそう}{自信|じしん}をつけてくれた。
examples.english: This experience gave me even more confidence.

examples.japanese: {一層|いっそう}の{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
{夜|よる}になると{一層|いっそう}{静|しず}かになる。
examples.english: It becomes even quieter at night.

examples.japanese: {一層|いっそう}のご{協力|きょうりょく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
examples.english: We ask for your further cooperation.

notes:
{一層|いっそう} emphasizes an increase in degree.

USAGE:
- Formal/literary compared to もっと
- Often used in writing and formal speech
- Emphasizes intensification

SIMILAR WORDS:
- もっと: more (conversational, common)
- さらに: furthermore, additionally
- {一層|いっそう}: all the more (formal, emphatic)
